CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL($User.TimeZoneSidKey, 'Europe/London'), OriginalEffectiveDate >= DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(OriginalEffectiveDate))) & "-03-21 00:00:00"), OriginalEffectiveDate < DATETIMEVALUE(TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(OriginalEffectiveDate))) & "-10-27 00:00:00") ), OriginalEffectiveDate - (1/24), OriginalEffectiveDate )
CustomField.label: Effective Date
